title: Scoliosis Shared Decision Making
brief_summary: Analysis of video encounters between providers, patients, and families will be used to develop a shared decision making tool for patients deciding between surgery and observation for scoliosis treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Scoliosis curve \>40 degrees, \< 65 degrees
* Risser score \> 2
* Age \> 13 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* Risser score of 0 or 1
* Non-ambulatory scoliosis patients
* Ages 12 year and under
